questions.prompt: What does unrolling a loop by 4 with separate accumulators buy?
options: Loop overhead paid once per 4 bodies
A bigger block for the scheduler
questions.explanation: It costs registers, not saves them.

questions.prompt: Why won't a compiler split a float sum into 4 accumulators on its own?
options: Float addition isn't associative: it changes the result, so it needs permission (fast-math)

questions.prompt: Three memory-bound elementwise kernels each read and write an n-element array. Fused into one, what fraction of the DRAM traffic remains?
questions.explanation: One read and one write instead of three of each.

questions.prompt: Which transform turns A[i * stride] computed every iteration into a pointer bumped by stride?
A fused kernel is slower than the separate ones. First suspect?
options: Register pressure from more live values, lowering occupancy or causing spills
questions.explanation: Check registers and spills before anything else.
